newsitem.title: USA: Enviro Recovery granted salvage rights.
newsitem.headline: Enviro Recovery granted salvage rights.

text.p: Enviro Recovery Inc said Tuesday it was granted permission by the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers to remove sunken logs from Lake Superior.
The decision was made after consulting with state and local government agencies and addressing concerns of environmental and Native American groups, the company said in a news release.

Superior Water-Logged Lumber Company Inc, a subsidiary of Enviro Recovery, salvages and mills virgin timbers recovered from the bottom of Lake Superior. The logs have proven to be perfectly preserved because of the low oxygen content and cold water conditions of Lake Superior.
The logs are used for furniture, musical instruments, flooring and paneling.
